tasks.subject: Task 1: Real to_snapshot from ZoneGroupTopology (pure mapping)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace group-of-one to_snapshot(Vec<Device>) with to_snapshot(Vec<ZoneGroupInfo>) -> DiscoverySnapshot (real speakers+groups, satellites folded, coordinator-first, vanished ignored) — pure fn, TDD against captured real spike XML.

**Files:** Modify native/crates/wire/src/adapter.rs (replace to_snapshot + to_snapshot_* tests; add use sonos_api::services::zone_group_topology::{self, ZoneGroupInfo};)

**Acceptance Criteria:** SpeakerIdentity per top-level member (unparseable IP skipped); satellites not emitted; GroupIdentity per ZoneGroupInfo coordinator-first, coordinator-absent skipped; grouped XML -> 1 group/2 speakers/coordinator-first; .105 coordinator-not-first reordered.

**Verify:** cargo nextest run -p oto-wire grouped_topology coordinator_reordered -> PASS

tasks.subject: Task 2: discover() fetches ZoneGroupState (multi-responder); drop DeviceDescription

**Files:** Modify native/crates/wire/src/adapter.rs (rewrite discover(); remove to_devices + sonos_discovery import; keep extract_ip); native/crates/wire/src/control.rs (add fetch_zone_group_state; extend services import with zone_group_topology).

**Acceptance Criteria:** fetch_zone_group_state build/execute/map_sdk_err/parse (parse fail->Backend); discover() multi-responder fallback (all fail->Network; 0->NoDevicesFound); to_devices+sonos_discovery removed (grep empty); cache test updated; oto-wire suite green.

tasks.subject: Task 3: D2 — speaker_state resolves transport to the coordinator
tasks.description:

**Files:** Modify native/crates/wire/src/adapter.rs (SonosWire struct + new/Default, populate_caches, Wire::speaker_state, resolve_transport_addr); native/crates/wire/src/control.rs (soap_speaker_state(speaker_addr, transport_addr)).

**Acceptance Criteria:** speaker_to_coordinator cache populated member->coordinator; speaker_state vol/mute@speaker transport@coordinator solo==self; unknown->NotFound; unit: non-coordinator transport addr == coordinator addr.

**Verify:** cargo nextest run -p oto-wire resolve_transport_addr && just check

